tool_schemas.name: searchContacts
tool_schemas.description: Searches contacts using a free-text query plus structured filters and returns a paged list of matching contact records; results are ordered by the provided sort and paged with limit (max 200) and an opaque cursor to fetch the next page, optionally embedding each contact’s notes when include_notes is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filter/sort shapes are invalid (including unknown filter keys, missing sort.field/sort.direction when sort is provided, out-of-range limit, invalid date-time ranges, or IDs that fail required patterns), and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the requested workspace or group. Raises NOT_FOUND when a referenced workspace_id or group_id does not exist or is not visible to you, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

query.description: Free-text query across contact name/title/company/location and identifiers.

filters.description: Structured filters to narrow contact results.

workspace_id.description: Restrict results to a specific workspace.

group_id.description: Only contacts who are active members of the given group.

company.description: Exact or partial match on company name.

company_domain.description: Exact match on company domain (e.g., example.com).

title.description: Exact or partial match on job title.

location.description: Exact or partial match on location.

email.description: Match contacts containing this email in emails array.

phone.description: Match contacts containing this phone in phones array.

social_link.description: Match contacts containing this URL/handle in social_links array.

created_at.description: Filter by contact creation time range.

gte.description: Created at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

lte.description: Created at or before this timestamp (inclusive).

updated_at.description: Filter by contact last update time range.

gte.description: Updated at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

lte.description: Updated at or before this timestamp (inclusive).

last_interaction_at.description: Filter by last interaction timestamp range.

gte.description: Last interaction at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

lte.description: Last interaction at or before this timestamp (inclusive).

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

include_notes.description: Whether to include notes for each returned contact.

tool_schemas.name: searchInteractions
tool_schemas.description: Searches interactions with free-text plus structured filters and returns a paged list of matching interaction records; results are ordered by the provided sort and paged with limit (max 200) and cursor, optionally including the full primary contact record for each interaction when include_contacts is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter/sort payloads (including unknown filter keys, missing sort.field/sort.direction when sort is provided, out-of-range limit, invalid date-time ranges, invalid numeric ranges for relevance_score, or IDs that fail required patterns), and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the specified workspace or to the group used for filtering. Raises NOT_FOUND when a referenced workspace_id, group_id, or primary_contact_id does not exist or is not visible to you, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

query.description: Free-text query across interaction title/body preview/participants and linked contact names.

filters.description: Structured filters to narrow interaction results.

workspace_id.description: Restrict results to a specific workspace.

primary_contact_id.description: Only interactions whose primary contact matches this contact id.

group_id.description: Only interactions whose primary contact is an active member of this group.

external_source.description: Filter by external source name (e.g., calendar provider).

gte.description: Occurred at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

lte.description: Occurred at or before this timestamp (inclusive).

start_at.description: Filter by start_at time range (typically for meetings/events).

gte.description: Start at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

lte.description: Start at or before this timestamp (inclusive).

end_at.description: Filter by end_at time range (typically for meetings/events).

gte.description: End at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

lte.description: End at or before this timestamp (inclusive).

gte.description: Relevance score greater than or equal to this value.

lte.description: Relevance score less than or equal to this value.

limit.description: Maximum number of interactions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

include_contacts.description: Whether to include full primary contact records for matched interactions.

tool_schemas.name: aggregateContacts
tool_schemas.description: Computes aggregate statistics over a contact set defined by query and filters and returns only numeric counts/percentages (never individual contacts); this endpoint is not paged because it returns summary values for the full matched set. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filters are invalid (including unknown filter keys, invalid date-time ranges, or IDs that fail required patterns) and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the requested workspace or group. Raises NOT_FOUND when a referenced workspace_id or group_id does not exist or is not visible to you, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

query.description: Free-text query used to scope the contact set being aggregated.

filters.description: Structured filters to define the contact set being aggregated.

workspace_id.description: Restrict aggregation to a specific workspace.

group_id.description: Only contacts who are active members of the given group.

company.description: Exact or partial match on company name.

company_domain.description: Exact match on company domain (e.g., example.com).

title.description: Exact or partial match on job title.

location.description: Exact or partial match on location.

created_at.description: Filter by contact creation time range.

gte.description: Created at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

lte.description: Created at or before this timestamp (inclusive).

last_interaction_at.description: Filter by last interaction timestamp range.

gte.description: Last interaction at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

lte.description: Last interaction at or before this timestamp (inclusive).

metric.description: Which numeric metric to compute over the matching contact set.

group_by.description: Optional dimension to bucket counts into categories.

limit.description: Maximum number of buckets to return when using group_by.

tool_schemas.name: getContact
tool_schemas.description: Get details for a contact by id, including emails, social links, phone numbers, and notes.

include_notes.description: Whether to include notes for this contact.

notes_limit.description: Maximum number of notes to include when include_notes is true.

notes_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of notes.

tool_schemas.name: createContact
tool_schemas.description: Create a new contact record in Clay. This endpoint should only be used when you need to create a completely new contact, not for adding contacts to groups.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to create the contact in.

full_name.description: Contact full name (if provided, may be used to populate name fields).

emails.description: List of email addresses for the contact.

phones.description: List of phone numbers for the contact.

social_links.description: List of social profile links/handles for the contact.

source.description: Source label indicating where this contact came from.

tool_schemas.name: createNote
tool_schemas.description: Create a note for a contact. Only use this when the user explicitly asks to create, add, or save a note.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to create the note in.

contact_id.description: Contact id the note belongs to.

created_by.description: Identifier for the creator (e.g., user id or email) if available.

tool_schemas.name: getGroups
tool_schemas.description: Get all groups or lists for the user.

workspace_id.description: Restrict groups to a specific workspace.

query.description: Free-text search over group name and description.

limit.description: Maximum number of groups to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: createGroup
tool_schemas.description: Create a group or list for the user. If a group with the same name already exists, it will not create a duplicate unless explicitly requested to ignore the check.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to create the group in.

ignore_duplicate_name_check.description: If true, create even if another group with the same name exists.

tool_schemas.name: updateGroup
tool_schemas.description: Update a group or list. Use this to update the group title and/or modify its members. When adding or removing contacts, provide ALL contact IDs to add/remove in a single call - do not make multiple calls for individual contacts.

group_id.description: ID of the group/list to update.

add_contact_ids.description: Contact IDs to add as members in this single update call.

remove_contact_ids.description: Contact IDs to remove as members in this single update call.

tool_schemas.name: getNotes
tool_schemas.description: Use ONLY when the user explicitly mentions "note" or "notes" to retrieve notes between two dates (e.g. "what notes from last week?"). Returns notes by creation date only - does NOT search note content or filter by other criteria. NEVER use this tool for finding contacts or any other purpose besides retrieving notes. This tool is strictly prohibited from being used unless "note" or "notes" are explicitly mentioned in the query.

start_date.description: Inclusive start of the notes created_at date-time range (ISO 8601).

end_date.description: Exclusive end of the notes created_at date-time range (ISO 8601).

contact_id.description: Optional contact ID to restrict results to notes for a single contact.

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

sort.description: Sort order for notes by creation time.

tool_schemas.name: getEvents
tool_schemas.description: Returns the user’s calendar events whose start time falls within the given range, from start_date (inclusive) to end_date (exclusive), sorted by start time as requested; results are paged with limit (1–200) and an opaque cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if start_date/end_date are missing, not valid ISO-8601 date-times, end_date is not after start_date, limit is out of range, sort is not one of the allowed values, or cursor is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated for the Clay account, and FORBIDDEN if the token lacks permission to read calendar events.

start_date.description: Inclusive start of the event time range (ISO 8601).

end_date.description: Exclusive end of the event time range (ISO 8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

sort.description: Sort order for events by start time.
